business_problem: replace an inflexible marketing analytics stack with a more scalable platform that could lower data costs, improve client-level transparency, and support profitable analytics products.
solution_summary: BVK uses Snowflake, Secure Data Sharing, and Snowflake Marketplace on Snowflake to replace an inflexible marketing analytics stack with a more scalable platform that could lower data costs, improve client-level transparency, and support profitable analytics products. Campaign and client analytics data are centralized in Snowflake so BVK can run shared agency insights and isolate usage by client more cleanly. The new platform eliminates many of the workarounds and pricing constraints from the prior stack, while governed sharing and productization features help BVK package insight more efficiently. Agency teams and clients use the faster reports and dashboards to understand campaign performance, while BVK tracks platform consumption more transparently for billing and monetization. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI.
